name: Vue
description: Vue-specific architecture guidance. Vue deliberately avoids prescribing one universal application folder architecture, so this profile only records conventions supported by official Vue documentation.

rules.title: Extract composables around logical concerns
rules.summary: As component complexity grows, extract logical concerns into composables rather than keeping large components monolithic.

rules.title: Do not treat one folder layout as a Vue requirement
rules.summary: Vue's official style guide is Vue-code focused and explicitly allows mindful deviations, so application-layer folder structure should come from composed ecosystem or Harness architecture profiles rather than being presented as a Vue mandate.

sources.title: Composables | Vue.js
sources.notes: Official guidance describes composables as reusable/organizational units and compares extracted composables to component-scoped services.

sources.title: Style Guide | Vue.js
sources.notes: Official Vue-specific style guide; it explicitly notes that no style guide is ideal for every team/project.
